Job.JobTitle: Complex/Severe Represented Litigation Adjuster - Florida - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented/Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

As a Represented/Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


The Customer Service Expert you will live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator you will use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver you will utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder you will protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+years of Florida Represented 3rd partyBodily Injury claim handling experience.
  • Experience managing severe, complex, and litigated Bodily Injury claims.
  • Knowledge of Florida tort reform.
  • Florida 6-20 All Lines Adjuster License (Property & Casualty).
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.

  • A home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Job.JobTitle: Summer 2027 - Underwriter Intern
Job.JobDescription:
We are seeking an Underwriting Intern to join our team!


The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.


The Underwriting Intern will support the Underwriting team by assisting with risk analysis, portfolio management, reporting, and underwriting processes that help drive informed business decisions and profitable growth. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in insurance underwriting, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration while developing foundational skills for a career in underwriting and risk management.


Underwriting Analysis & Development (80%)

  • Assist the Underwriting team with data collection, analysis, and reporting of key underwriting and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Support the review and evaluation of underwriting results, trends, risk characteristics, and financial performance.
  • Assist in the preparation of underwriting reports, presentations, and business insights for internal stakeholders.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support underwriting strategies, pricing initiatives, and risk management decisions.
  • Help identify opportunities for process improvements and support the development of more efficient underwriting practices.
  • Utilize reporting and analytical tools to manage and interpret underwriting data in support of various projects.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, finance, product, and operations teams to support business objectives.

Project Management & Continuous Improvement (20%)

  • Participate in team meetings and brainstorming sessions to support underwriting initiatives and business solutions.
  • Assist in documenting underwriting processes, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support special projects related to portfolio management, risk assessment, business analytics, and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to process mapping and workflow optimization efforts.

Learning & Development Opportunities

In this role, the intern will have the opportunity to gain experience, enhance skills, and develop competencies that prepare them for future underwriting and risk management roles, including:

  • Exposure to a corporate insurance and underwriting environment
  • Understanding of underwriting principles and risk evaluation
  • Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills
  • Advanced use of data analysis and reporting tools
  • Experience working with business performance metrics and portfolio analysis
  • Ability to develop business recommendations supported by data and research
  • Experience presenting findings and insights to stakeholders
  • Exposure to cross-functional collaboration and business decision-making

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years completed and currently enrolled in a 3rd or 4th year undergraduate program in Risk Management, Finance, Business Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master's degree candidates will also be considered.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and basic modeling.
  • Interest in insurance, underwriting, risk assessment, and business analytics.

Other Skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Professional demeanor and positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to learn new systems and applications quickly.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and making sound recommendations based on available information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience using data visualization or analytical tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar) is a plus.
  • Coursework in insurance, risk management, finance, statistics, or related disciplines preferred.

Remote Opportunity

Paid Internship: $22/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027

Strategic Leadership & Portfolio Management

Stakeholder Communication & Influence

  • Coordinate Product and Network Management interests for emerging product lines

  • Evaluate existing provider programs and processes to identify opportunities for modernization, simplification, scalability, and measurable improvement

  • Translate emerging business needs, industry trends, and operational insights into future-state strategies and actionable provider solutions

  • Strong problem-solving skills, effective interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to develop and maintain strong and effective business relationships
  • Ability to act in a strong consultative and influencer role across all levels of leadership, including executive leaders
  • Ability to balance innovation with operational feasibility, scalability, provider experience, regulatory requirements, and measurable business outcomes.

Data Science Lead

The Data Science Lead will be a lead member of the AGRC North America Data & Analytics (D&A) team, driving the evolution of our advanced analytics and AI capabilities. This role is focused on designing, operationalizing, and scaling analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions that power Risk Consulting engagements.

The Data Science Lead will build robust data pipelines and models, create reusable analytics assets, and enable consultants and analysts with tools and frameworks that elevate the quality, speed, and consistency of analytics across the business. This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong business understanding, and a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Lead Advanced Analytics & AI DevelopmentCoordinate and contribute to the design and execution of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions using claims, exposure, operational, and external data to generate high-value insights for use across Risk Consulting.
  • Operationalize Scalable Data & Analytics FoundationsBuild, maintain, and optimize scalable data pipelines, feature stores, and reporting frameworks using tools such as SQL, Python, Alteryx, Databricks, and Power BI/Tableau to support repeatable, production-grade analytics.
  • Develop Reusable Analytics AssetsDesign and productionize reusable analytics components (e.g., models, data products, templates, and automated workflows) that can be embedded into multiple client engagements and solutions.
  • Data Quality, Governance, and AutomationDrive innovation in data management by profiling, cleansing, and integrating disparate data sources; define and automate data quality rules; and contribute to proactive data governance and stewardship practices.
  • Continuous Improvement & Technology AdoptionEvaluate and introduce emerging analytics, AI, and automation tools and techniques to continuously enhance the team's capabilities and efficiency.
  • Mentorship & Best Practice DevelopmentMentor junior analysts and data professionals, promote coding and analytics best practices, and help shape standards for model development, documentation, testing, and deployment.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Analytical & Technical Skills
    • Advanced analytical capabilities with a proven ability to interpret complex datasets, identify trends, and develop robust statistical, ML, and AI-driven solutions.
    • Expertise in data profiling, cleansing, and transformation, including scripting and automation of data quality rules.
    • Strong proficiency in managing relational databases, cloud-based data environments, and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Tooling & Platforms
    • Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI/Tableau, and Excel/VBA.
    • Familiarity with Databricks and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
    • Experience working with Access and other legacy systems is a plus.
  • Communication & Collaboration
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-relevant explanations for non-technical stakeholders.
    • Strong collaboration skills, working effectively with consultants, product owners, and other technical teams.
  • Work Environment & Mindset
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
    • Demonstrates a growth mindset, curiosity about new tools and methods, and a passion for innovation and continuous learning.

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Information Management
  • 5–7 years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data science, ideally within insurance, risk management, or consulting environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data modeling, statistical analysis, and predictive analytics, with hands-on experience using tools such as SQL, Python, R, and Alteryx.
  • Proficiency in data visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and experience designing client-facing dashboards and reports.
  • Strong understanding of ETL frameworks, data warehousing concepts, and cloud-based data ecosystems (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks).
